name: mysaline-theme
description: Development environment and build tooling for the MySaline WordPress theme.

scripts.setup: wp-env run cli wp theme activate mysaline && npm run seed && npm run permalinks
scripts.seed: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/mysaline-dev/seed-demo.php
scripts.permalinks: wp-env run cli wp rewrite structure '/%postname%/' && wp-env run cli wp rewrite flush
scripts.reset: wp-env clean all && wp-env start && npm run setup
scripts.lint:php: for f in $(find mysaline -name '*.php'); do php -l "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done && echo 'PHP OK'
